desc: Ideate approaches and identify pitfalls (empty subsequence, zeros, unsafe product pruning, sum bound).
Implement initial two-phase DP (positive products plus separate zero reachability).
Replace the initial solution with a simpler unified bitset DP that includes product 0 states and handles zeros in the same transition loop.
Run the three provided sample tests on the unified solution and report pass/fail.
Validate edge cases: |k| > sum(nums), all zeros, zeros enabling sums, ones, product 0 vs positive product, nums[i] > limit, zeros after product overflow.
Confirm no failures remain and finalize the solution.
